experiment: Phishing TF-IDF + Logistic Regression: registrable-domain holdout
interpretation: Exploratory within-dataset domain-held-out evaluation; not independently collected data or real-world validation.

target.0: benign according to the source dataset
target.1: phishing according to the source dataset
target.source_semantics_note: The candidate file identifies combined_reduced.json; its public source labels have not been independently adjudicated and no finer record-level source provenance is available.

baseline_reference.comparability: Different test components and split objective; metrics are contextual, not directly equivalent. This experiment also uses the currently active scikit-learn version recorded below.

preprocessing.group_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapsed whitespace (existing train_text_baseline.normalize_for_group)
preprocessing.model_preprocessing: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, collapsed whitespace (existing text_normalization.normalize_for_model)

near_duplicate.simhash: first 64 bits of SHA-256 per shingle

preprocessing.quarantine_policy: Reuse existing component-wide promotional-review and conflicting-label quarantine; quarantine propagates through all domain-connected components.

domain_extraction.normalization: Parse URL authority locally; lowercase, remove trailing dot, IDNA ASCII encoding, validate DNS labels; canonicalize IP literals.
domain_extraction.scheme_policy: HTTP/HTTPS and protocol-relative URLs are parsed; candidates without a scheme receive an HTTPS parse prefix. URL_RE from preparation is reused to identify scheme-bearing, www, and bare-domain URL-like tokens.
domain_extraction.html_policy: Prefer canonical URL, then og:url, then form actions, then all anchor destinations; do not group image, script, stylesheet, or other resource URLs.
domain_extraction.multi_url_policy: All extracted destination domains on a record are unioned with its existing near-duplicate component, preventing their domains from crossing partitions.

public_suffix_list.note: Uses the local JDK-bundled PSL through an internal JDK API; pin the JDK and PSL file hash for reproduction.

domain_extraction.ip_policy: IP literals use exact canonical IP grouping keys.
domain_extraction.unclassified_hostname_policy: If the local PSL does not return a registrable domain, use exact normalized host grouping only and mark it as fallback; never infer registrable domains using the last two labels.
domain_extraction.no_domain_policy: Retain records and group by normalized/near-duplicate text component only; report separately because they cannot demonstrate unseen-domain generalization.
domain_extraction.no_source_split: Only combined_reduced.json provenance is available; no source-level holdout is feasible.

model.threshold_policy: Fixed at 0.5 for comparability; no threshold selection or hyperparameter tuning was performed on validation or test data.

verification.validation_method: Computed by set-intersection assertions immediately before and after partition assignment.
